reason: S1 only reformats existing WUFFS_BASE__TOKEN constants and adds clang-format control comments; all macro names and numeric values are unchanged. H0 continues to exercise JSON decoding through fuzz_complex, fuzz_simple, and fuzz_cpp, while fuzz_one_token inspects token length, continuation, base category, and base detail. The commit introduces no new entry point, protocol, state, configuration, input semantics, or attack surface.
evidence: Both internal/cgen/base/token-public.h and release/c/wuffs-unsupported-snapshot.c retain the same values for WUFFS_BASE__TOKEN__LENGTH__MAX_INCL, the VALUE/CONTINUED/LENGTH shifts, all WUFFS_BASE__TOKEN__VBC__* constants, and all WUFFS_BASE__TOKEN__VBD__* constants.
The substantive additions are only // clang-format off, // clang-format on, separator comments, and whitespace alignment.
H0 includes release/c/wuffs-unsupported-snapshot.c and invokes wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens from both fuzz_complex and fuzz_simple.

fuzz_one_token consumes the unchanged token API via wuffs_base__token__length, wuffs_base__token__value_extension, wuffs_base__token__continued, wuffs_base__token__value_base_category, and wuffs_base__token__value_base_detail.
wuffs_base__make_token retains the identical body assigning repr to ret.repr and returning ret.
recommended_action: No harness change is needed for this commit.
